title: White Bean, Couscous, Dill & Feta Stuffed Peppers with Spinach Salad

steps.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and mince garlic. Peel and small dice onion.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, drain and rinse beans; set aside to drain further.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic and onion; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 2-3 minutes.
Add beans, broth, and spices to the pot; stir to combine and bring to a boil over high heat.
Once the liquid is boiling, remove from heat; add couscous and stir to combine. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack about 6-inches from the top.
Trim, seed, and halve bell peppers lengthwise. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, season with salt and pepper, then arrange cut-side down.
Place baking sheet in the oven and broil, flipping once, until peppers are tender and charred, 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, using a knife, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the pot with the cooked couscous.
Mince olives and artichokes; add both to the pot along with half the feta (reserving the rest for topping the peppers). Stir to combine the filling.
Divide couscous filling between pepper halves and top with reserved feta. Return baking sheet to the oven and broil until cheese is golden, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel and mince additional garlic. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, and spices; whisk to combine the dressing.
Mince walnuts. Add to the bowl with the dressing along with the spinach; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide peppers and salad between plates. Enjoy!
